transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you in today?

I… I came in because I’ve been thinking it might be better if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes it feels like… dying would be what I deserve, like punishment for what I’ve done to my family and my crew.
Have you been feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things that happened, even if they weren’t entirely your fault?

Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m the reason everything got worse. My husband, the crew losing work, the jobs going bad in people’s homes… it feels like I ruined it all. Like I poison whatever I touch, and… maybe I deserve whatever comes from that.
How long have you been feeling this way about yourself and your situation?
It’s been… a while. About a year and a couple months, I think. It started a few months after my husband got hurt. Since then it’s just kind of stayed with me.
Have you felt this way most days, and has it affected your daily life, like work, relationships, or things you used to enjoy?

Most days, yeah. It got bad enough that I had to stop leading the flooring jobs. I couldn’t really… keep track of the crew or deal with clients or make the calls on site safely. My apprentice and my husband started stepping in before I messed something up or got someone hurt.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like your work or time with family, don’t interest you as much anymore?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to paint, cook big meals, run before jobs, go to theater rehearsals. Now it all just feels like chores from somebody else’s life. If I miss it, I don’t really care.
Have you had any thoughts about how you would end your life, or have you made any plans about it?

I… I haven’t really made a plan. But I keep thinking it might be better if I just didn’t wake up. Sometimes it feels like dying would be… fair, I guess. Like punishment for what I’ve done to my family and my crew.
Have you made any specific plans about how you would end your life?

No… no specific plan. It’s more that I came in because I keep thinking I’d be better off not waking up. Sometimes it feels like dying would be… what I deserve, for what I’ve put my family and my crew through.
Have there been any periods of time during this last year and a couple of months when you felt significantly better, even for a few weeks, where these feelings lifted or weren’t as strong?

Not really. I mean… maybe some weeks weren’t as bad, like I could get through the day a little easier. But most of the time it’s still been there—the guilt, being tired, not caring about things… and those thoughts about not being here. It hasn’t really lifted.
Have you had any periods of time during this last year and a couple of months when you felt significantly better, even for a few weeks, where these feelings lifted or weren’t as strong?

I don’t think so. Maybe a week here or there felt a little less heavy, but… most of the time it’s still been there. The guilt, being worn out, not really wanting to do much… and the thoughts about death. It hasn’t really gone away.
Before this current period of feeling down and having these thoughts, have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt this way?
I… I’m not really sure. I’ve had rough patches before, I guess, but I don’t know if it was like this. I don’t really want to get into all that right now.

Before this current period of feeling down and having these thoughts, have you ever had any other times in your life when you felt similarly—down, guilty, or not interested in things—for a period of weeks or more?
I don’t really know. I’ve had times where I was down before, yeah, but… I can’t say if it was for weeks like this or the same kind of thing. I don’t really remember it clearly.
Looking back, can you recall if you ever had a period lasting weeks or more before this current one where you felt down, guilty, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I honestly can’t say. I know I’ve had low times before, but remembering if it lasted weeks or if it was like this… it’s kind of blurry.

Before this current period of feeling down and having these thoughts, were there any times in your life when you felt similarly—down, guilty, or not interested in things—for weeks at a time, and were those times clearly separated by at least a couple of months where you felt better?
I don’t know… I can’t really separate it out like that. I’ve had times I felt low, but whether it was weeks and then a couple months better after… I’m not sure.

Before this current period of feeling down and having these thoughts, were there any times in your life when you felt this way for weeks at a time, and if so, were there clear periods of at least two months in between when you felt like yourself again?
I’m not really sure. I can remember feeling low at different points, but I can’t sort out whether it was weeks like this, or if there were clear months where I felt totally like myself in between.

Before this current time, can you remember having any other separate periods where you felt down, guilty, or lost interest in things for weeks at a time, and if so, were there times in between when you felt like yourself for at least two months?
I can’t really pin that down. I know there were times I felt bad before, but whether they were separate like that, with two months of feeling normal in between… I don’t know.

Looking back on your life before this current period, were there any other times when you felt down, guilty, or lost interest in things for weeks at a time, and if so, were there clear periods of at least two months in between when you felt like yourself again?
I don’t really know. I’ve felt off before, yeah, but I can’t say if it was separate periods like that or if I had two months where I felt normal in between. It all kind of blurs together.

Looking back, can you remember if there were any other times in your life when you felt down, guilty, or lost interest in things for weeks at a time, and if so, were there at least two months in between those times when you felt completely like yourself again?

I still can’t really tell. I remember feeling down at different times, but I don’t know if it was like separate stretches, or if there were two whole months where I felt completely okay in between. It’s hard to sort out.

Looking back, can you remember if there were any other times in your life when you felt down, guilty, or lost interest in things for weeks at a time, and if so, were there at least two months in between when you felt completely like yourself again?
I don’t know. I’ve had times where I felt low, but I can’t really separate it out like that… or say there were two full months where I was completely myself. It’s just not clear to me.
